text_block_list.text:
Biwa Hayahide and I have been out
walking for
quite a while.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
We've gone a pretty long way. You must
be tired.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Since we still have plenty of time, why
don't we
take a break and have some
tea before heading
back?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
One of my favorite cafes is around here,
so let's
go there.
She leads the way to our destination.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: It's just past that corner over there.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Huh? That's strange...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
They're closed, though they're usually
open at
this time...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Perhaps. Well, let's try somewhere else.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I heard a nice outdoor cafe just opened
down the
street.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I haven't been there yet, but this is the
perfect
opportunity to try it.

We arrive at a very fancy cafe with a sign

declaring it to be owned and managed
by a
celebrity barista.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Wow, a celebrity barista runs it? It's no
wonder
this menu is so elaborate.

This seems like a place for the younger
crowd.
There are dozens of drinks to
choose from, and
the selection of
desserts is just as varied.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
This is nothing like the establishments I
usually
frequent, but it's the perfect
place to bring a
friend.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: It deserves a spot on my list, for sure.

With a highly skilled hand, Biwa
Hayahide writes
down the cafe's name.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Yes, sometimes with friends, and
sometimes just
by myself.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
They're the perfect place to read a book
on a
rainy day.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
They're the perfect place to read a book
on a
rainy day.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
At first, I was merely looking for a nice
spot to
read at, but now it's become
something of a
habit.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Oh. Speaking of books, there's one I'd
like to
recommend to you.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
It's an autobiography by a legendary

Umamusume...
She takes the book out from her bag almost too nonchalantly.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I know it's rare in this age of
digitization,
but...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I think I've just gotten used to having
books in my
bag. It helps me feel at
peace.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...Anyway, this book is quite interesting.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I think you could learn a lot from it as a
trainer.
Why don't you give it a try?

I spend some time reading with Biwa
Hayahide...

While I'm at it, I gain some direct insight
into how
she hones her intellect on a
daily basis.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Of course.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: But first, I need to know your criteria.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Yes. For example, do you plan to go on
a
weekday or the weekend? And will
you be there
in the morning, afternoon,
or evening?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Do you plan to go by yourself or with
others?
Additionally, are you looking for
somewhere that
specializes in food or in
drink?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Of course, there are also the issues of
location
and how far you are willing to
travel.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
The more information you can give me,
the more
well-equipped I'll be to
recommend you a place.

For a moment, I feel like I'm talking with
a real
estate agent because of how
detailed her
inquiries are.

But with her quick thinking and
analytical skills,
she really is able to
make the best possible
recommendation
for me.
